<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\ReadModels\TransferManagement\Queries;

use App\Contexts\Alliance\Membership\Enums\MembershipStatus;
use App\Contexts\Alliance\Membership\Enums\RosterState;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Access\Enums\TransferPermission;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Access\Services\TransferAuthorization;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Models\TransferCohort;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Models\TransferGroup;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Models\TransferKingdomCapacityObservation;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Models\TransferKingdomConditionObservation;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Models\TransferPlan;
use App\Contexts\GameWorld\KingdomTransfers\Models\TransferWindow;
use App\ReadModels\TransferManagement\Presenters\TransferManagementPresenter;
use App\Shared\Infrastructure\Pagination\PageSlice;
use App\Shared\Infrastructure\Pagination\ScopedCursorCodec;
use Illuminate\Auth\Access\AuthorizationException;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Builder;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder as QueryBuilder;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Illuminate\Validation\ValidationException;
use stdClass;

/** Read-only, currently authorized management projection; never an eligibility/write authority. */
final readonly class TransferManagementCollectionsQuery
{
    public const int PAGE_SIZE = 25;

    public function __construct(
        private TransferAuthorization $authorization,
        private ScopedCursorCodec $cursors,
        private TransferManagementPresenter $presenter,
    ) {}

    /** @return array{page:array<string,mixed>,total:int} */
    public function catalogue(string $actor, string $alliance, string $kind, ?string $planId = null, ?string $groupId = null, ?string $cursor = null): array
    {
        $this->authorize($actor, $alliance);
        if (! in_array($kind, ['plans', 'windows', 'cohorts', 'officialGroups', 'conditions', 'capacities', 'groupKingdoms'], true)) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['collection' => 'Choose a Transfer management collection.']);
        }
        $plan = in_array($kind, ['plans', 'windows'], true) ? null : $this->plan($alliance, $planId);
        if ($kind === 'groupKingdoms') {
            $group = TransferGroup::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)
                ->where('transfer_window_id', $plan?->transfer_window_id)->whereKey($groupId)->firstOrFail();
            $query = DB::table('transfer_group_kingdoms as membership')
                ->join('kingdoms as kingdom', 'kingdom.id', '=', 'membership.kingdom_id')
                ->where('membership.transfer_group_id', $group->id)->select(['kingdom.id', 'kingdom.number']);
            $rows = $this->page(DB::query()->fromSub($query, 'group_kingdoms'), $this->scope($actor, $alliance, $kind, $planId, $groupId), $cursor);

            return $this->output($rows, static fn (Model|stdClass $row): array => $row instanceof stdClass ? ['id' => (string) $row->id, 'number' => (string) $row->number] : throw new \LogicException('Expected a scalar Kingdom projection.'));
        }
        $query = match ($kind) {
            'plans' => TransferPlan::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)
                ->whereHas('window', fn (Builder $q) => $q->where('alliance_id', $alliance))->with(['homeKingdom', 'window']),
            'windows' => TransferWindow::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance),
            'cohorts' => TransferCohort::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->where('transfer_plan_id', $plan?->id)
                ->with(['coordinator:id,current_name', 'destinationKingdom:id,number']),
            'officialGroups' => TransferGroup::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->where('transfer_window_id', $plan?->transfer_window_id)->withCount('kingdoms'),
            'conditions' => TransferKingdomConditionObservation::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->where('transfer_window_id', $plan?->transfer_window_id)->with('kingdom:id,number'),
            'capacities' => TransferKingdomCapacityObservation::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->where('transfer_window_id', $plan?->transfer_window_id)->with('kingdom:id,number'),
        };
        $rows = $this->page($query, $this->scope($actor, $alliance, $kind, $planId), $cursor);

        return $this->output($rows, fn (Model|stdClass $row): array => match (true) {
            $row instanceof TransferPlan => $this->presenter->plan($row),
            $row instanceof TransferWindow => $this->presenter->window($row),
            $row instanceof TransferCohort => $this->presenter->cohort($row, true),
            $row instanceof TransferGroup => $this->presenter->officialGroup($row),
            $row instanceof TransferKingdomConditionObservation => $this->presenter->condition($row),
            $row instanceof TransferKingdomCapacityObservation => $this->presenter->capacity($row),
            default => throw new \LogicException('Unexpected Transfer catalogue row.'),
        });
    }

    /** @return array{page:array<string,mixed>,total:int,selected:array{id:string,name:string}|null} */
    public function options(string $actor, string $alliance, string $kind, ?string $planId = null, string $search = '', ?string $cursor = null, ?string $selectedId = null): array
    {
        $this->authorize($actor, $alliance);
        $search = trim($search);
        if (! in_array($kind, ['windows', 'cohorts', 'members', 'roster'], true) || mb_strlen($search) > 160
            || ($selectedId !== null && ! Str::isUlid($selectedId))) {
            throw ValidationException::withMessages(['q' => 'The Transfer choice request is invalid.']);
        }
        if ($kind === 'cohorts') {
            $this->plan($alliance, $planId);
        }
        // These are authorized scalar read compositions, not foreign mutations or a new membership authority.
        $base = match ($kind) {
            'members' => DB::table('alliance_memberships as membership')->join('players as player', 'player.id', '=', 'membership.player_id')
                ->where('membership.alliance_id', $alliance)->where('membership.status', MembershipStatus::Active->value)
                ->selectRaw('player.id AS id, player.current_name AS name'),
            'roster' => DB::table('alliance_roster_entries as roster')->where('roster.alliance_id', $alliance)
                ->whereIn('roster.state', [RosterState::Active->value, RosterState::Tracked->value])
                ->selectRaw('roster.id AS id, roster.observed_name AS name'),
            'windows' => DB::table('transfer_windows')->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->selectRaw('id, label AS name'),
            'cohorts' => DB::table('transfer_cohorts')->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->where('transfer_plan_id', $planId)
                ->where('state', 'active')->select(['id', 'name']),
        };
        $query = DB::query()->fromSub($base, 'transfer_choices');
        $selected = $selectedId === null ? null : (clone $query)->where('id', $selectedId)->first();
        if ($search !== '') {
            $query->where('name', 'ilike', '%'.str_replace(['\\', '%', '_'], ['\\\\', '\\%', '\\_'], $search).'%');
        }
        $rows = $this->page($query, $this->scope($actor, $alliance, 'options:'.$kind, $planId, $search), $cursor);
        $choice = static fn (Model|stdClass $row): array => $row instanceof stdClass ? ['id' => (string) $row->id, 'name' => (string) $row->name] : throw new \LogicException('Expected a scalar selection projection.');

        return [...$this->output($rows, $choice), 'selected' => $selected === null ? null : $choice($selected)];
    }

    private function authorize(string $actor, string $alliance): void
    {
        if (! $this->authorization->allows($actor, $alliance, TransferPermission::Manage)) {
            throw new AuthorizationException;
        }
    }

    private function plan(string $alliance, ?string $id): TransferPlan
    {
        return TransferPlan::query()->where('alliance_id', $alliance)->whereKey($id)
            ->whereHas('window', fn (Builder $q) => $q->where('alliance_id', $alliance))->firstOrFail();
    }

    private function scope(string $actor, string $alliance, string $kind, ?string $plan, ?string $filter = null): string
    {
        return 'transfer-management:'.hash('sha256', json_encode([$actor, $alliance, $kind, $plan, $filter], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR));
    }

    /** @param Builder<covariant Model>|QueryBuilder $query
     * @return array{items:list<Model|stdClass>,next:?string,total:int,first:bool}
     */
    private function page(Builder|QueryBuilder $query, string $scope, ?string $cursor): array
    {
        $total = (clone $query)->count();
        $through = null;
        if ($cursor !== null) {
            $p = $this->cursors->decode($cursor, $scope);
            if (array_keys($p) !== ['after', 'through'] || ! is_string($p['after']) || ! is_string($p['through'])
                || ! Str::isUlid($p['after']) || ! Str::isUlid($p['through']) || strcmp($p['after'], $p['through']) > 0) {
                throw ValidationException::withMessages(['cursor' => 'The Transfer collection position is invalid.']);
            }
            $through = $p['through'];
            $query->where('id', '<', $p['after']);
        } else {
            $through = (clone $query)->max('id');
        }
        if (is_string($through)) {
            $query->where('id', '<=', $through);
        }
        $rows = $query->orderByDesc('id')->limit(self::PAGE_SIZE + 1)->get();
        /** @var list<Model|stdClass> $items */
        $items = array_values($rows->take(self::PAGE_SIZE)->all());
        $last = $items === [] ? null : $items[array_key_last($items)];
        $id = $last instanceof Model ? $last->getKey() : ($last->id ?? null);

        return ['items' => $items, 'next' => $rows->count() > self::PAGE_SIZE && is_string($id) && is_string($through)
            ? $this->cursors->encode($scope, ['after' => $id, 'through' => $through]) : null, 'total' => $total, 'first' => $cursor === null];
    }

    /** @param array{items:list<Model|stdClass>,next:?string,total:int,first:bool} $rows
     * @param  callable(Model|stdClass):array<string,mixed>  $present
     * @return array{page:array<string,mixed>,total:int}
     */
    private function output(array $rows, callable $present): array
    {
        return ['page' => (new PageSlice(array_map($present, $rows['items']), $rows['next'], self::PAGE_SIZE, $rows['first']))->toArray(), 'total' => $rows['total']];
    }
}
